name: Vantage
description: Vantage's hosted server queries cloud cost reports, budgets and anomalies across providers.

probe.note: Answers an unauthenticated initialize with 401 and publishes OAuth metadata; the authorization server (mcp.vantage.sh) offers dynamic client registration, so a harness can sign in without a pre-registered app. The sign-in itself was not completed by this check.
